description: The 09:20 morning raise with real pre-market prices

sources.R: morning raise from the real 09:20 price
sources.O: morning raise from the open (the #539 proxy), every day
sources.Om: morning raise from the open, only on days R has a price
sources.Rf: R when the 09:15 bar traded (price at most 5 minutes old)
sources.H: half the gap: previous close + 0.5 x (R - previous close)
sources.L: R when at least $500k traded in 09:00-09:20
sources.G2: R when within 2% of the previous close
